stories.title: Tata Motors completes its Iveco takeover with an 89.42% stake
stories.summary: Tata Motors has completed the initial settlement of its tender offer for Iveco Group, buying about 89.42% of the Italian truckmaker for 14.4 euros a share in cash. Iveco is now an indirect subsidiary of Tata Motors. Settlement closed on 30 October.

stories.title: Maruti Suzuki heads for more than 2.5 lakh wholesales in October
stories.summary: Maruti Suzuki is poised to cross 2,50,000 total wholesales in October on festive demand, with domestic dispatches expected above 2,15,000, sources told the Financial Express. September total wholesales were 2,36,000. The festive season, once again, has turned up on schedule.

stories.title: Suzuki passes Honda in global sales, and India is why
stories.summary: Suzuki has overtaken Honda as Japan's second-largest carmaker by global sales. It sold 18,24,006 vehicles from April to September, and 11,00,260 of them were domestic wholesales in India. Sales in Japan fell slightly to 3,54,040. The home market is now the away market.

stories.title: Maruti Dzire crosses 35 lakh units of production
stories.summary: The Maruti Suzuki Dzire has crossed 35 lakh units of cumulative production about 18 years and nine months after it began in January 2008, joining the Alto, Swift and WagonR. Domestic sales of 1,25,988 units put it ahead of the Punch from April to September.

stories.title: Gujarat overtakes Uttar Pradesh in October car sales
stories.summary: Gujarat recorded 41,552 car sales in October as of 28 October, India's second highest, according to road transport ministry data cited by the Times of India. Maharashtra led with 44,632 and Uttar Pradesh recorded 38,233. Gujarat was third in October 2025.

stories.title: Tata Motors launches the new Punch in South Africa
stories.summary: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles has launched the all-new Punch in South Africa with Motus Holdings, priced from R224,900, about Rs 11.7 lakh. It comes in three variants with two petrol engines. In India the Punch has crossed 8 lakh customers.

stories.title: Festive EV sales are a poor guide to real demand, says Autocar Pro
stories.summary: Autocar Professional argues that festive spikes in commercial EV sales are a temporary signal driven by discounts and financing. Fleet utilisation, uptime and post-season performance are a better guide to long-term demand, especially for electric two-wheelers in last-mile delivery. The gifts are seasonal, the deliveries are not.

stories.title: Hyundai's Bayon carries a lot of weight for one SUV
stories.summary: Hyundai has launched the mid-sized Bayon, its first major launch since the Creta Electric in January 2025, Fortune India notes, after a phase of steady market share losses. It sits between the Creta and Venue and is widely seen as a rival to Maruti Suzuki's Victoris.

stories.title: Range Rover SV Sawai collection launched at Rs 4.90 crore
stories.summary: Range Rover has launched the SV Sawai collection in India, inspired by Jaipur, Jodhpur and Jaisalmer, at Rs 4.90 crore. It is limited to 18 vehicles globally, six of each edition, and is the third special India collection for the SUV.

stories.title: Maserati GT2 Stradale arrives in India at Rs 5.72 crore
stories.summary: Maserati has introduced the GT2 Stradale in India at Rs 5.72 crore ex-showroom. The road-legal version of its GT2 racer builds on the MC20 with a twin-turbo V6, revised suspension and brakes, and weighs 60kg less. Only 914 will be made globally.

stories.title: Gautam Singhania tells buyers to beware Maserati's India relaunch
stories.summary: Raymond chairman Gautam Singhania has criticised Maserati's India relaunch on Instagram and X, alleging poor after-sales service and an unresolved complaint, and warned prospective buyers. His remarks followed five model launches and a new Mumbai dealership. The company has not responded publicly.

stories.title: Maruti Suzuki marks a Victoris year with an Aurum Edition
stories.summary: Maruti Suzuki has launched the Victoris Aurum Edition for the SUV's first anniversary, based on the strong hybrid variant, with a kit priced at Rs 22,990. The company says the Victoris recorded the highest first-year sales of any new passenger vehicle launch in India.

stories.title: Hyundai's Punch EV rival will likely be called Ioniq P
stories.summary: Hyundai Motor India is set to enter the mass-market EV segment by January 2027 with a compact SUV codenamed HE1i, likely to be called Ioniq P, the Financial Express reports. Hyundai Motor Company mentioned it on an earnings call. The Indian arm has not confirmed the name.

stories.title: JSW Combat plug-in hybrid interiors spied before December launch
stories.summary: JSW Motors will enter the Indian market on 4 December with the Combat, a premium plug-in hybrid SUV that is a badge-engineered Jetour T2, Cartoq reports. New spy shots of the interior show a cabin that looks much like the Jetour T2's.

stories.title: MG Windsor EV prices go up by Rs 15,000
stories.summary: JSW MG Motor India has raised Windsor EV prices by Rs 15,000 across all variants, which now range from Rs 14.85 lakh to Rs 19.15 lakh ex-showroom. The recently launched Indulge Edition is not part of the hike and stays at Rs 18 lakh.

stories.title: Two-wheeler sales and exports cross 1.52 crore in H1
stories.summary: India's two-wheeler domestic sales and exports crossed 1.52 crore units from April to September, up about 20% year on year, RushLane reports. Domestic sales rose 17.63% to 1,20,86,812 units and exports grew 31.86% to 32,07,357. Scooters grew faster than motorcycles.

stories.title: Bajaj, TVS and Hero post strong September quarters
stories.summary: The top three listed two-wheeler makers reported strong September quarter revenue as domestic demand, exports and e-scooters outweighed commodity costs, Forbes India reports. Bajaj Auto posted its first Rs 20,000 crore revenue quarter, with net profit up 35%. Hero MotoCorp had the weakest earnings of the three.

stories.title: Hero Vida crosses 2 lakh electric scooter sales in 2026
stories.summary: Hero's Vida sold 2,00,143 electric scooters between 1 January and 29 October, against 1,13,021 in all of 2025, BikeJunction reports. October was its best month yet at 27,435 units, a 66% rise on October 2025.

stories.title: Electric two-wheeler registrations reach 2.15 lakh in October
stories.summary: Electric two-wheeler registrations rose 2.9% to 2,14,654 units in October from September, with TVS Motor and Hero MotoCorp gaining share, according to Vahan data cited by Inc42. That is 48.1% higher than October last year.

stories.title: GST 2.0 weighs on bikes above 350cc
stories.summary: SIAM data for April to September shows the 40% GST slab for motorcycles above 350cc has put pressure on the segment, the Financial Express reports, with the 350 to 500cc category down 41%. Bikes under 350cc moved to 18%. The tax code now sets engine sizes.

stories.title: Bajaj Auto to lift electric two-wheeler capacity to 80,000 a month
stories.summary: Bajaj Auto plans to raise monthly electric two-wheeler capacity to about 80,000 by the end of March from about 60,000, as Chetak demand exceeds output. A supply chain disruption had cut recent production to around 40,000, said joint managing director Rakesh Sharma.

stories.title: Ultraviolette launches the X-47 Venom at Rs 2.65 lakh
stories.summary: Bengaluru's Ultraviolette has launched the X-47 Venom electric crossover motorcycle at an introductory Rs 2.65 lakh for the first 5,000 buyers, against a standard Rs 3 lakh. It debuts a 100-volt powertrain with an 11kWh battery. European deliveries begin in early 2027.

stories.title: Ather bets that most riders need less range than they buy
stories.summary: Ather Energy expects low-range electric scooters to drive sales, Mint reports, since its average customer rides 27 to 28 km a day. Premium scooters offer 160 to 200 km. Rival Ola Electric is betting on higher range. Range anxiety, meet range arithmetic.

stories.title: Honda CB350C Black Edition launched at Rs 2.32 lakh
stories.summary: Honda has launched the CB350C Black Edition at Rs 2.32 lakh ex-showroom, positioned against the Royal Enfield Classic 350, Business Today reports. It gets a darker colour scheme and blacked-out elements, and Honda has shared little else officially. It is the same motorcycle in a different mood.

stories.title: Pakistan's Sazgar opens a three-wheeler plant in the Philippines
stories.summary: Sazgar Engineering has opened a three-wheeler plant in the Philippines' Laguna province with annual capacity of about 12,000 vehicles, making both electric and combustion models. Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jr attended the inauguration, Digital Pakistan reports.

stories.title: Ather Energy turns profitable in the September quarter
stories.summary: Ather Energy reported a net profit of Rs 1.26 crore in Q2 FY27 against a loss of Rs 154.07 crore a year earlier, as total income rose 62% to Rs 1,527 crore. Electric two-wheeler penetration hit a record 11.6%. A profit of Rs 1.26 crore still counts.

stories.title: Ather is now worth over 3.5 times Ola Electric
stories.summary: Around 29 October Ather's market capitalisation stood near Rs 65,000 crore against roughly Rs 16,000 crore for Ola Electric, Cartoq reports. Ather shares have risen from a Rs 326 listing price to about Rs 1,600, while Ola trades more than 50% below its IPO price.

stories.title: Delhi crosses its EV charging target three months early
stories.summary: Delhi had 14,225 EV charging points as of 30 September, beating the December target of 13,913 set by the Commission for Air Quality Management, officials said. The city added 5,312 points between January and September. Targets are usually the thing that runs late.

stories.title: Gadkari asks Maharashtra to cut daytime EV charging to Rs 5 a unit
stories.summary: Road transport minister Nitin Gadkari asked Maharashtra to cut EV charging tariffs to Rs 5 a unit between 8 am and 6 pm, and suggested Rs 8 to Rs 10 after 6 pm. He spoke in Pune at the inauguration of EKA Mobility's six new facilities.

stories.title: India's EV index shows a widening gap between states
stories.summary: The India Electric Mobility Index 2025 from WRI India and NITI Aayog ranks Delhi first, followed by Maharashtra and Karnataka, across 28 states and eight Union Territories. Some states built chargers without matching adoption, while others grew EV use with weak charging networks, Policy Circle notes.

stories.title: VinFast pitches itself as an accelerator for India's EV market
stories.summary: VinFast says it sees India's young electric car market as an opportunity to speed up adoption. Electric cars made up 8.5% of passenger vehicle retail sales in September, with registrations nearly doubling from a year earlier, according to industry data cited by The Samikhsya.

stories.title: A Las Vegas startup wants to revive EV batteries with X-rays
stories.summary: X-Regen, a UNLV startup founded by physics professor Michael Pravica, is developing X-ray technology to regenerate lithium-ion batteries. He describes a shop visit where an accelerator under the car restores capacity from about 60% to 85 or 90%. Coffee, he suggests, is optional.

stories.title: Tata Motors and Iveco plan up to 1.5 billion euros a year in joint R&D
stories.summary: Corporate filings show the combined Tata Motors and Iveco can deploy up to 1.5 billion euros a year on joint research, targeting zero-emission powertrains, alternative fuels and software-defined vehicles, Autocar Professional reports. Tata bought its 89.42% stake at 14.40 euros a share.

stories.title: JSW Greentech sells its first 100 Ampstar electric tractor trucks
stories.summary: JSW Greentech has made its first commercial sale of Ampstar electric trucks, an order for 100 55-tonne 4x2 tractor trucks for haulage at JSW Cement in Vijaynagar, with JSW Eco-Mobility providing battery as a service. The trucks have CMVR certification from ARAI. The customer is also the family.

stories.title: EKA Mobility opens six plants in a Rs 3,500 crore plus push
stories.summary: EKA Mobility, with Pinnacle Industries and group companies, inaugurated six manufacturing facilities across Maharashtra and Madhya Pradesh at an event in Pune on 31 October. The companies describe it as one of India's largest integrated manufacturing platforms for electric commercial vehicles.

stories.title: Michelin launches a Chennai-made truck tyre that promises fuel savings
stories.summary: Michelin has launched the X Multi Energy Z2 commercial vehicle tyre in India, made in Chennai and on sale from 1 November. It claims up to 6% better fuel efficiency in one size and up to 13% in another, compared with leading competitors.

stories.title: Escorts Kubota raises tractor prices across three brands
stories.summary: Escorts Kubota will raise prices across its Kubota, Farmtrac and Powertrac tractors from November, after the festive season, citing raw material, energy, logistics and manufacturing costs. Increases will vary by model and region. The festive discount, it turns out, had an expiry date.

stories.title: Tractor sales may hit a three-year low on weak rainfall
stories.summary: Tractor sales are heading for a 10% decline this fiscal and could reach a three-year low as uneven rainfall hurts farming, News9live reports, citing The Economic Times. Entry-level two-wheelers and cars with large rural markets are also feeling the pressure.

stories.title: An Alberta-made low-tech tractor finds buyers worldwide
stories.summary: A Bowden, Alberta parts and servicing outlet builds the Ursa 150, an all-mechanical tractor with no computer codes, CBC reports. Owner Doug Wilson says his phone has been ringing with farmers wanting to cut equipment costs and fix breakdowns themselves. The new feature is the missing features.

stories.title: Motherson Sumi Wiring Q2 profit rises 35% to Rs 223 crore
stories.summary: Motherson Sumi Wiring India reported Q2 FY27 net profit of Rs 223.37 crore, up 35% year on year, as revenue grew 47% to Rs 4,053.83 crore on higher vehicle content and volumes across EV and combustion platforms, Autocar Professional reports.

stories.title: Ramkrishna Forgings revenue jumps 55% in Q2
stories.summary: Ramkrishna Forgings reported Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue of Rs 1,405.42 crore, up 54.9%, and net profit of Rs 70.59 crore against a loss of Rs 9.5 crore a year ago. EBITDA more than doubled to Rs 256.23 crore and margin rose to 18.2%.

stories.title: Wheels India Q2 profit jumps 88% on exports
stories.summary: Chennai-based Wheels India posted Q2 FY27 net profit of Rs 60 crore, up 88%, as revenue rose 36% to Rs 1,723 crore, Business Standard reports. Exports grew to Rs 388 crore, helped by US demand for construction equipment and windmill components.

stories.title: Schaeffler India revenue grows 27.4% in the September quarter
stories.summary: Schaeffler India's standalone Q3CY26 revenue was Rs 30,058 million, up 27.4% year on year, according to its investor presentation. EBITDA margin slipped to 18.7% from 19.1% in the previous quarter, which the company put down to input costs and fuel price effects.

stories.title: SPR Auto Technologies Q2 revenue rises to Rs 16.48 billion
stories.summary: SPR Auto Technologies, formerly Shriram Pistons and Rings, reported consolidated Q2 revenue of Rs 16.48 billion against Rs 10.20 billion a year earlier, Sahi reports. The company's core auto component divisions drove the growth. Pistons, rings and a new name, all moving faster.

stories.title: Apollo Tyres' five Indian plants win British Safety Council awards
stories.summary: All five of Apollo Tyres' Indian manufacturing units have received the British Safety Council's Five-Star Rating and Sword of Honour 2026 for occupational health and safety management, Motor India reports. The company says it reflects its focus on safety culture and operational discipline.

stories.title: Timken India gets BIS licences for two Bharuch plants
stories.summary: Timken India has received Bureau of Indian Standards licences for spherical roller bearings from its new Bharuch facility and cylindrical roller bearings from its older one. The company expects the certification to ease OEM qualification, shorten lead times and simplify tender paperwork.

stories.title: Amazon India's two-wheeler sales rise sixfold in the festive sale
stories.summary: Amazon India recorded a sixfold rise in two-wheeler sales during its Great Indian Festival 2026, with tier 2 and tier 3 locations making up over 60% of transactions. Commuter motorcycle sales grew 13.5-fold and EVs eightfold. The showroom is now also a shopping cart.

stories.title: Maserati opens a third Indian flagship dealership in Mumbai
stories.summary: Maserati has opened a flagship dealership in Mumbai with Navnit Motors, its third in India after Delhi and Bengaluru, and showcased its refreshed 2027 range, CarWale reports. The brand says India is no longer just another market on its expansion map.

stories.title: AutoMovers Group plans Rs 500 crore for 200 outlets
stories.summary: AutoMovers Group plans to invest Rs 500 crore to grow to more than 200 outlets in three to five years across North and Central India, including EV-ready workshops. It runs over 100 outlets today, with dealerships for Mahindra, Tata Motors, Kia, Skoda, Jeep and others.

stories.title: River Mobility crosses 100 showrooms and targets 200 by March
stories.summary: Electric scooter maker River Mobility has crossed 100 showrooms in India within three years of starting operations, after opening 10 in a single day, BW Auto World reports. Its network spans 65 cities across 12 states. It aims for 200 outlets by March 2027.

stories.title: Hybrid car dispatches fall 9% in September
stories.summary: India's hybrid passenger vehicle dispatches fell 9% year on year to 8,918 units in September, Autopunditz reports. Toyota's Innova Hycross and Urban Cruiser Hyryder held the top two spots, and the Kia Sorento entered the top five.

stories.title: Consumer court tells Ola Electric to replace a scooter or refund Rs 1.02 lakh
stories.summary: A consumer court has directed Ola Electric to replace an electric scooter or refund its price of over Rs 1 lakh to a buyer in Aligarh, Cartoq reports. The scooter reportedly developed problems on purchase day and stopped working within two days.

stories.title: CapGrid raises Rs 50 crore led by Hero Enterprise's fund
stories.summary: Delhi NCR manufacturing startup CapGrid has raised Rs 50 crore in a Pre-Series B round led by Hero Enterprise Venture Partners, valuing it at Rs 430 crore, Inc42 reports. It will fund higher-end precision components and expansion into drones and data centres.

stories.title: IRDAI declares November grievance resolution month
stories.summary: IRDAI says about 2.21 lakh insurance cases were pending before consumer commissions and courts as of 31 March, 72.49% of them for over a year, and about 11 lakh before Motor Accidents Claims Tribunals. It has named November 'Grievance Resolution Month' to speed up resolution.

stories.title: New India Assurance posts a Rs 1,267 crore Q2 loss
stories.summary: State-owned New India Assurance slipped to a Rs 1,267 crore loss in Q2 while gross written premium rose 5.14% to Rs 11,083 crore. Chair Lavanya R Mundayur cited a steep fall in property rates and large-risk losses and flood claims in the property segment.

stories.title: Himachal High Court rules a private car occupant is not a third party
stories.summary: The Himachal Pradesh High Court has held that an occupant of a private car covered by an Act-only policy, with no extra premium paid, is a gratuitous passenger and not a third party, allowing an insurer's appeal. It criticised the judicial officer for not examining the policy.

stories.title: Ola Electric closes its Rs 1,000 crore rights issue
stories.summary: Ola Electric closed the subscription period of its rights issue on 30 October. It sought to raise up to Rs 1,000 crore through partly paid-up equity shares, with the window running from 22 October. The board approved the terms on 7 October.

stories.title: Jefferies upgrades Rivian to buy after a 30% slide
stories.summary: Jefferies raised Rivian to buy from hold, calling a roughly 30% fall in the shares over three months a favourable entry point, and kept a $17 target. The stock rose more than 5% on Friday but remains about 42% down this year.

stories.title: Researchers catalogue hundreds of car software vulnerabilities
stories.summary: Researchers at the University of Gothenburg and Chalmers University of Technology analysed 413 reported automotive software vulnerabilities, and external applications made up the largest share at 36.2%, ScienceAlert reports. The study appeared in Software Quality Journal. The weak point is increasingly the app, not the axle.

stories.title: Tesla now pays referrals in Full Self-Driving, not car rewards
stories.summary: Tesla's new US referral programme gives a referred owner one free month of FSD (Supervised), and the referrer a free month or a $99 credit if that person starts paying, Electrek reports. Vehicles no longer qualify for referral rewards. Bring a friend, get software.

stories.title: Rivian and Ford scale up 3D printing to cut costs
stories.summary: Automakers including Ford and Rivian are expanding 3D printing for parts, assembly tools and test units, CNBC reports. Jared Beck, head of Rivian's additive manufacturing, said the company would be 'democratizing 3D printing for the entire company'. The factory has started printing parts of itself.

stories.title: Europe's robotaxi programmes pick up pace
stories.summary: Bolt plans to start gathering real-world driving data in Madrid in 2027, subject to regulatory approval, for its planned European robotaxi programme. Lucid, Mercedes-Benz, Volkswagen Commercial Vehicles, Volvo Cars and Einride also outlined higher levels of automation at Nvidia's GTC Berlin event.

stories.title: Volkswagen unveils VEGA, a technology stack built in China
stories.summary: Volkswagen Group has unveiled VEGA, a China-developed stack combining EV platforms, software architecture and driver assistance, at its first Tech Day in China. Under its 'In China, Beyond China' strategy it plans to export China-built vehicles and technology to the Global South.

stories.title: 42dot sends its first over-the-air update to Gleoo AI
stories.summary: Hyundai's 42dot is delivering the first over-the-air update for Gleoo AI, its large language model in-car voice assistant introduced in May on The New Granzer. The update adds route stop suggestions and fuel prices by type, following customer feedback.

stories.title: Hyundai shortlists 16 startups from 980 applications
stories.summary: Hyundai Motor India has concluded the first Hyundai Innovation Challenge 2026, shortlisting 16 startups from 980 applications across India, V3Cars reports. It is supported by Hyundai Motor Group's open innovation platform ZER01NE and aims to build mobility collaborations.

stories.title: Oritek and QNX team up on ADAS chips for China
stories.summary: Oritek Semiconductors and BlackBerry's QNX said QNX's SDP 8.0 has been ported to Oritek's Longquan 560 series chip for China's driver assistance market. The solution is already in a forward-facing camera project at a major Chinese automaker, Gasgoo reports.

stories.title: Delhi bars non-BS VI vehicles from other states from 1 November
stories.summary: From 1 November to 31 January 2027, vehicles registered outside Delhi that do not meet BS-VI norms are barred from entering the city to curb air pollution, The Tribune reports. The ban covers all categories, including goods carriers and buses.

stories.title: India permits E100 ethanol for flex-fuel vehicles
stories.summary: The road transport ministry has amended the Central Motor Vehicles Rules to permit E100, or 100% ethanol, in flex-fuel vehicles, notified on 23 October. Emission and testing norms for E85 now include E100. It does not mean every petrol car can use it.

stories.title: Panchayats to host EV charging stations on village land
stories.summary: The Ministry of Panchayati Raj has signed an MoU with CESL to set up EV charging and battery swapping stations on Panchayat land, Business Standard reports. The aim is extra revenue for rural local bodies and clean mobility infrastructure beyond cities.

stories.title: Volkswagen's India import duty case returns to the Bombay High Court
stories.summary: The government defended its customs demand of about $1.2 billion to $1.4 billion against Volkswagen at the Bombay High Court on 29 October, arguing the company did not submit import information on time. Volkswagen's lawyer said the law allows only a five-year lookback, not 12.

stories.title: NHAI caps future toll plazas at eight lanes
stories.summary: NHAI has made multi-lane free flow tolling part of all future national highway projects, capping toll plazas at eight lanes, the Times of India reports. Some plazas near cities currently have over 20 lanes, and some up to 32. Gantries will do the work of booths.

stories.title: Kolhapur RTO seizes 10 bike taxis in a crackdown
stories.summary: Kolhapur's regional transport office has seized 10 two-wheelers used for Rapido bike taxi rides and urged citizens not to use such services, saying it has granted no bike taxi app permission to operate in the district, the Times of India reports.

stories.title: FIA-level racing returns to Buddh after 13 years
stories.summary: Buddh International Circuit hosted FIA-level racing for the first time in 13 years with the Indian Racing League and F4 Indian Championship. Drivers rated the track highly, but organisers say 30 to 40% of it needs revamping before it can host Formula 1 again.

stories.title: Antonelli can clinch the F1 title in Mexico, at 1:30am IST
stories.summary: The Mexico City Grand Prix runs on 1 November, which in India means a 1:30am IST start on Monday. Mercedes driver Andrea Kimi Antonelli could secure his first world championship, entering the weekend 123 points ahead of George Russell. Alarms will be set.

stories.title: MotoGP heads to Sepang with Marquez ten points clear
stories.summary: Ducati's Marc Marquez takes a 10-point lead into the Malaysian Grand Prix at Sepang, the 19th round of the season, Motorsport.com reports. Nearest rival Jorge Martin of Aprilia is attempting to race with a broken arm after a high-speed crash in Australia.

stories.title: India's clean mobility debate needs an agricultural lens
stories.summary: A TradingView commentary argues the question is what vehicles run on. EVs are about 11% of vehicle sales in 2026 and nearly 43% of passenger three-wheelers sold this year, and the piece points to the paddy fields of Punjab and Haryana as a fuel source.

stories.title: Amazon and Tata Motors plan 3,000 electric trucks in India
stories.summary: Amazon and Tata Motors plan to deploy 3,000 electric trucks across Amazon's logistics network in India, moving shipments between fulfilment centres, across cities and along national freight corridors. It is described as the largest electric truck deployment by an e-commerce company in India.

stories.title: When electric cars were the quiet choice
stories.summary: IEEE Spectrum looks back at the early car industry, when US carmakers grew from about 50 in 1898 to five times that a decade later, and production rose from 7,000 in 1901 to 181,000 by 1910. Electric, steam and petrol cars competed, and nobody knew who would win.

stories.title: Volkswagen delays the electric Golf to save money
stories.summary: Volkswagen has delayed the electric Golf, planned as the ID. Golf, as part of sweeping cost cuts announced on its third-quarter earnings call, CarBuzz reports. VW leads EV sales in Europe but says it is not making enough money on them.

stories.title: Kia keeps its 3.35 million sales target but warns on profit
stories.summary: Kia expects to meet its annual sales target of 3.35 million vehicles but fall short of its profitability goal, citing the Middle East war, raw material costs and a stronger won. Q3 operating profit rose 24% to 1.82 trillion won on US tariff relief.

stories.title: Skoda grows deliveries 6.1% and stays Europe's second best-selling brand
stories.summary: Skoda Auto increased deliveries 6.1% in the first nine months of 2026, defended its position as Europe's second best-selling brand and raised operating profit 7.4%, with an 8.3% return on sales. It warned of tougher competition and margin pressure next year.

stories.title: Europe's Chinese vehicle crackdown revives Australia's factory question
stories.summary: Europe's tougher stance on Chinese-made vehicles has revived talk of car manufacturing in Australia, a decade after Holden and Toyota closed their plants, Yahoo News reports. Experts say expansion by BYD and Chery overseas could reopen the door to local production.

stories.title: JLR's Solihull factory expansion clears an early hurdle
stories.summary: Solihull council has confirmed that Jaguar Land Rover's plans to redevelop its Lode Lane plant will not need a full Environmental Impact Assessment. The proposals, tied to EV production including the Range Rover Electric, include a new paint shop and testing facilities.

stories.title: Hyundai climbs to 29th in Interbrand's global brands ranking
stories.summary: Hyundai ranked 29th in Interbrand's Best Global Brands 2026 with a brand value of $25 billion, moving to fourth among automotive brands from sixth. Toyota led the carmakers at $59.5 billion, followed by Mercedes-Benz and BMW, CarGuide.PH reports.
